answer_1.quote: In this paper, we address the challenging task of summarizing television shows ...
answer_1.outputs: textual summaries of TV show episodes

answer_2.quote: We present results, as measured by ROUGE-1 (r1), ROUGE-2 (r2), ROUGE-Lsum (rlsum) ... and our new PRISMA metric.

answer_3.quote: In our implementation, we used GPT4-Turbo for the extraction of atomic facts and the estimation of whether they are supported ...
methods: fact extraction and per-fact support assessment

answer_4.quote: We selected 8 episodes from SummScreen3D, and asked human participants (recruited through the Prolific platform) to watch the episode, then rank summaries in order of perceived quality.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were instructed to prioritize informativeness and factual correctness, with a secondary emphasis on fluent well‑written text.
